services.name: Disc Golf Course
services.desc: In March 2022, Enterprise Parks and Recreation officially opened the LZ Disc Golf Course. This 18-basket course is located at Johnny Henderson Family Park, and was designed by Zach Cole, Don Cropenbaker, Adam Morrow, and Todd Walz . Disc Golf is one of the fastest growing sports globally and is known as a lifetime fitness activity for people of all ages. Disc golf is a flying disc sport in which players throw a disc at a target. It is played using rules similar to golf. The sport is usually played on a course with 9 or 18 holes.
